description: This source file implements functionality related to generating patch IDs in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for parsing diff outputs, computing hash-based patch IDs, and handling command-line options for the 'git patch-id' utility.

methods.name: void flush_current_id(size_t patchlen,struct object_id * id,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Outputs the current patch ID if patch length is non-zero.

methods.name: size_t remove_space(char * line)
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from a line and returns the length of the cleaned string.

methods.name: int scan_hunk_header(const char * p,int * p_before,int * p_after)
methods.description: Parses a hunk header line to extract line number ranges for diff hunks.

methods.name: size_t get_one_patchid(struct object_id * next_oid,struct object_id * result,struct strbuf * line_buf,int stable,int verbatim)
methods.description: Reads input lines to compute a patch ID based on diff hunks, handling binary and text patches, and updates hash context.

methods.name: void generate_id_list(int stable,int verbatim)
methods.description: Generates a list of patch IDs for all diffs read from stdin.

methods.name: int git_patch_id_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Reads configuration options related to patch ID stability and verbatim processing.

methods.name: int cmd_patch_id(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git patch-id' command, parsing options, reading configuration, and generating patch IDs.
